name: Frost on the glass
notes: N1110: the second wording of attention_sab_truck, chosen per night by FS47Attention::SabScript (same beats and timing, other thoughts and trace text).

beats.text: Frost on the hood and nothing else. It is not that cold.
At {clock} the truck would not turn over. Frost covered the hood and nowhere else, and the cab smelled of hot wiring.
Two tubes died back at the station. I can get a pair at the Caliche shop counter.
